name: StdMailBot
description: High-performance Telegram Temp Mail Bot built in Go with MongoDB persistence, dual-engine mail generation (TempMail.io + 1secmail), auto OTP & magic link extraction, and auto inbox watch.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Bot Owner

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Connection String (MongoDB Atlas or standalone)

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username to force users to join before generating emails (without @)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID for audit logs (optional, e.g. -1001234567890)
